neighbours.label: the comma closing a short introductory hedge or adverbial phrase ('For all we know,', 'As far as I can tell,')
fire: As far as I can tell, nobody has opened the box yet.
For all I know, she might already be in Paris.
To be honest, the soup was a little too salty.
As far as we know, the bridge will reopen next week.
For all they knew, the storm had passed the coast.
In my opinion, the second film was better than the first.
Strangely enough, the cat refused to go outside today.
As it turns out, the keys were in his jacket all along.
quiet: I can tell that nobody has opened the box yet.
She might already be in Paris by now.
The soup was honestly a little too salty.
We know the bridge will reopen next week.
They knew the storm had passed the coast.
I thought the second film was better than the first.
The cat strangely refused to go outside today.
The keys were in his jacket all along.
